content: {"episode_id":"ep-05279","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), denied under PR-204 as not covered under the member’s current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate, raising clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia. The mobile cardiac telemetry study was ordered for continuous rhythm monitoring to capture the arrhythmia during symptomatic events and guide further management."}
